title: Neural Bloom Post-Processing Lab
description: A BrainStem model floats above a SpecularSilkPouf pedestal in a dark scene. The user manipulates a chain of six post-processing effects—Bloom, ChromaticAberration, DepthOfField, Vignette, ColorGrading, and FilmGrain—each with intensity sliders, while maintaining a total 'energy budget' that cannot exceed 100 units across all effects. An undo/redo stack tracks every change, and toggling any effect redistributes leftover energy proportionally among active effects.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 and the postprocessing library (pmndrs/postprocessing via CDN). Load BrainStem.glb and position it at (0,1.5,0) with its animation mixer playing. Load SpecularSilkPouf.glb and place it at (0,0,0) as a pedestal beneath the brain. Use a PerspectiveCamera at (0,2,5) with OrbitControls. Add a dim ambient light (0.15) and a point light (intensity 2) at (2,4,3). Set the renderer background to black. Build an EffectComposer with six togglable effects: BloomEffect, ChromaticAberrationEffect, DepthOfFieldEffect, VignetteEffect, HueSaturationEffect (for color grading), and a noise-based FilmGrain via NoiseEffect. Create a left-side HTML panel with six rows, each containing a checkbox to enable/disable the effect, a range slider (0-30) for intensity, and a numeric readout. Enforce a conservation law: the sum of all active slider values must not exceed an energy budget of 100. When a slider is dragged, clamp it so the total stays at or below 100. When an effect is toggled off, redistribute its energy proportionally among remaining active effects. When toggled on, it starts at 0. Implement an undo/redo system: every slider change or toggle push a state snapshot onto an undo stack (max 30). Wire Ctrl+Z to undo and Ctrl+Shift+Z to redo, restoring all slider values and toggle states. Display the current total energy as a bar at the top of the panel that changes color from green (<50) to yellow (<80) to red (>=80). The BrainStem animation speed should scale with total energy divided by 100, coupling animation to post-processing intensity. Ensure at least 10-14 interaction steps are needed to configure all six effects meaningfully under the budget constraint.
